name: Coma Cluster (Hubble)
blurb: The Coma Cluster, a cluster of galaxies, seen by Hubble.
label: comacluster-hubble
story: A window into the Coma Cluster, Abell 1656, a great gathering of galaxies. Hubble's treasury survey imaged the cluster's core and infall region to study its dwarf galaxies, which hierarchical models count among the earliest galaxies.

claims.text: The Coma cluster is a cluster of galaxies
The survey imaged the core and infall region of the Coma cluster
The survey studied the dwarf galaxy population, which hierarchical models count among the earliest galaxies
COMA5-5 is a field (visit) of HST program 10861
